class="accordion-jss__content cp-text">Melanin is a natural pigment that gives the skin colour. Exposure to <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/basic-skin-knowledge/sun-and-the-skin" target="">sunlight</a>, hormonal influences, and ageing can increase melanin production and trigger hyperpigmentation. <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/uneven-skin/hyperpigmentation" target="">Hyperpigmentation</a> appears as dark circles around the eyes, dark patches, and <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/indications/age-spots" target="">age spots</a> (also known as <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/about-skin/indications/age-spots" target="">sun spots</a>) that make the skin look uneven. The fresh and lightweight formula, Eucerin® Anti-Pigment Dark Circle Eye Corrector, combines powerful active ingredients that work in different ways to promote your skin's radiance, reduce hyperpigmentation, and brighten and smooth your eye area at the source. • <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/t/thiamidol" target="">Thiamidol</a>®, an effective and patented ingredient that acts at the root cause of hyperpigmentation by reducing melanin production from day 1 with first visible results in 2 weeks with regular use. It is clinically and dermatologically proven to reduce all types of dark spots and prevent their re-appearance. • Light-reflecting pigments brighten under the eye area for an instantly fresh, awake look. • Hyaluronic Acid reduces puffiness and smoothens <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">fine lines</a>. • Oligopeptides stimulate the skin's collagen network for firmer skin structure. The cream can be applied easily and precisely to small areas of hyperpigmentation and has a cooling metal applicator for optimal performance. In just two weeks first results are visible with skin appearing smoother and more even, refined and with a fresh and awake look. •Very good tolerability and efficacy, even on <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/sensitive-skin/dry-sensitive-facial-skin" target="">sensitive skin</a>. •Suitable for contact lens wearers. •Ophthalmologically tested.</div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="media"><picture loading="lazy"><source It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:
</p>
<p>Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.
</p>
<p>Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.
</p>
<p>Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.</p></div><a class="key-ingredients__link cp-link-s" href="/our-research/ingredients/t/thiamidol">Learn More</a></div></div><div class="key-ingredient-item col-6"><div class="key-ingredients__content"><div class="hdl-4">Hyaluronic acid</div><div class="cp-text-m"><p style="margin: 2pt 2.85pt 2pt 0in;">Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.</p></div><a class="key-ingredients__link cp-link-s" href="/our-research/ingredients/h/hyaluronic%20acid">Learn More</a></div></div></div></div><div class="pdp-ingredients-section__link-container"><div class="pdp-ingredients-section__main-link btn secondary-btn"> <!-- -->View all</div></div></div></section><section class="uk-section cp-container faq-section"><div class="cp-row cp-row-center"><div class="cp-section-content"><div class="title hdl-3">FAQ</div><div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Can I use Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care alongside other Eucerin moisturisers? </p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care can be used alone or integrated into any skincare routine. We recommend that you use Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum twice a day, in the morning and evening.  </p>
<p>If you experience hyperpigmentation but it is not your primary skin-ageing concern, then you may want to apply Eucerin Anti-Pigment Skin Perfecting Serum before one of our anti-ageing care products such as: <br />
<br />
<a href="/products/hyaluron-filler/day-care-spf-30">Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Day SPF 30</a>, which plumps up fine lines and deep wrinkles for a rejuvenated look <br />
<br />
<a href="/products/hyaluron-filler/hyaluron-filler-moisture-booster">Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Moisture Booster</a> for an immediate moisture boost </p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Will this product protect my delicate skin from UV damage? </p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care does not protect skin from the sun. As the sun’s rays are a key contributor to hyperpigmentation it’s important to wear an appropriate sun protection product, even on cloudy days. We recommend that, if you apply Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care in the morning, you follow it with <a href="/products/anti-pigment/day-cream-spf-30">Eucerin Anti-Pigment Day SPF 30</a> to help fade existing acne marks and protect skin from the sun, thereby reducing further sun-induced pigmentation issues. For intense sun exposure choose a higher protection factor from the <a href="/products/sun-protection">Eucerin Sun Protection range</a>.  </p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>How can I boost my skin’s radiance? </p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care can be used effectively as part of your regular skincare routine to make your skin more even and radiant. You can also adopt <a href="/skin-concerns/uneven-skin/how-to-get-radiant-skin-tips">certain self-care habits at home</a> to increase your skin’s glow. </p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Can I use this eye cream under my make-up? </p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Yes. Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care is an excellent make-up base for your eyes. </p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Would you like your skin to look more even? </p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p>Eucerin Dark Circle Illuminating Eye Care corrects and reduces any type of dark circles for an immediate fresh and awake look.
